resources.string: Receive MelKit news and app links. Tap a notification to open its app page on Google Play.
See the latest updates and apps.
Your mods and creations, all together
Browse, back up, restore and check game files. Manage individual mods and switch groups.
Browse mods, maps, and saves with search, sorting, and multiple selection.
Keep full or selected backups outside the game folder, and choose what to restore.
A safe place for your creations
Choose game files, then pair the two phones with a QR code over Wi-Fi Direct.
Choose content, then show a QR code
Collect selected mods, maps, saves, and worlds into one shareable bundle.
This ZIP is not a supported MelKit bundle, or contains invalid or unsafe entries. No game files were written.
File verification failed. Try another copy of the bundle.
The operation could not finish. An interrupted save may leave an incomplete ZIP at the selected location.
Create groups for cars, battles, and more. Switch groups while keeping essential mods enabled.
Move unused mods to a separate vault and restore them when needed, without downloading them again.
Review empty and duplicate files, supported-format errors, and files that could not be checked. Quarantine is reversible.
Organize your library with personal names and categories while preserving original game files.
Choose Organize file on a library card. Clear both fields to remove its display name and category.
Files with a display name or category will appear here.
No organized files match this search.
Could not save these details. Try again.
Choose a screenshot and crop a cover for your mod or bundle inside MelKit.
Choose Edit cover on a file card or while creating a bundle.
Could not read this image. Choose another photo.
Could not save this cover. Try again.
Review changes and undo supported operations with the original files preserved.
Completed operations will appear here with their date and time.
Restore a mod or quarantined file, or undo the latest group switch.
No group switch is available to undo.
Restore complete. Reopen the game to see the change.
Could not complete the operation. Refresh the list and try again.
Offline video: first-time pairing and everyday starts

Install Shizuku from its official download page. Open Shizuku and follow its wireless debugging and pairing instructions. Enter the pairing code in the Shizuku notification, start the service, then authorize MelKit when file access is available.
Usually, open Shizuku and start the service. Repeat pairing only if Shizuku or Android requests it.
Watch the English guide without internet. Pairing is needed for first-time setup; later, usually just open Shizuku and start the service.
Could not play the video. Try again, or return to the guide to read the setup steps.
Choose Arabic or English. The layout follows your language.
Import Melon Sandbox mods, maps, and files easily.
Import them with MMIX, then organize them here.
Fix and import Minecraft packs, add-ons, and worlds.
Back up, restore, and share your Minecraft content.
Explore more gaming tools from Spinel.
No app is available to open this link.
Privacy choices are unavailable. Please try again.
Access preview: browse and read files, or save a copy in Download/MelKit, organized by its game folder. Close the game first. Game files stay unchanged.
Start Shizuku, then connect and allow MelKit access when asked.
No supported content folders appeared here. Open Melon Sandbox and create a save or import a mod, then refresh.
The original game file is unchanged. This copy contains only the selected file.
Start Shizuku first, then return here and connect.
This Shizuku version is too old. Update it using the official download in the setup guide.
Access was not allowed. Open Shizuku, allow MelKit in Authorized applications, then connect again.
Could not connect to the file service. Check that Shizuku is running and MelKit is allowed, then retry.
This folder could not be found. Check that the game has created content, then return to game folders and refresh.
Access to this path was denied. Check Shizuku and MelKit authorization. This does not mean the files are damaged.
The file or folder could not be read. Refresh and try again. Its contents have not been classified as damaged.
This file changed after the folder was loaded. Close the game, refresh, then try again.
The copy could not be saved and verified in Download/MelKit. Any new incomplete copy was removed. Check free space and try again.
Allow storage access to save copies in Download/MelKit on Android 7–9, then tap Save a copy again.
The copy could not be verified, and its new document could not be removed. Check the destination and remove any incomplete copy before retrying. The game file is unchanged.
Could not open Shizuku. Use the setup guide for the official download.
Browse copies in Download/MelKit and restore a saved file to the game.
No saved copies yet. Save a file from the Library first.
Saved files are not accessible. On Android 7–9, allow storage access and refresh.
Could not load saved copies. Check the MelKit folder in Downloads and refresh.
Start Shizuku and allow MelKit access. You can also connect from the Library.
Close Melon Sandbox first. The saved copy will stay in Downloads. A file with the same name in the game will be kept unchanged.
A file with this name already exists in the game and was kept unchanged. Restore a new copy with a numbered name to keep both files.
Could not read the file counts. Try refreshing.
Could not complete and verify the restore. The saved copy is unchanged.
The restore did not finish and its new file could not be removed. Check the destination before trying again. The saved copy is unchanged.
Open Melon Sandbox and check that the restored file appears. Your saved copy remains in Downloads.
Connection ready. You can browse game files and save a copy.
Close the game before changing mods. Disable a mod to keep it in a separate vault, then enable it to return it to its original location.
Vault: Download/MelKit/DisabledMods. Safety copies remain after enabling and after uninstalling MelKit. Repeated toggles reuse an unchanged copy.
Safety copy — return it or confirm the identical mod already in the game
No mod files found in the game or disabled vault.
Close Melon Sandbox completely. MelKit will verify a safety copy before removing this mod from the game folder.
Close Melon Sandbox completely. The mod will return to its original location. A different existing file will never be replaced.
Mod disabled. Its verified copy is in the vault.
Mod returned to the game. Restart the game to use it.
A different file already exists at the original location. It was not replaced; the vault copy remains available.
The source or vault copy changed. The operation stopped. Refresh the list before trying again.
Not enough free storage for a verified copy. Free some space and try again.
The operation did not finish. Reconnect Shizuku and refresh the list. Check the game and vault states before retrying; existing vault copies are retained.
Could not read the mod list. Check access through Shizuku and refresh. This does not mean the mods are damaged.
Some vault records could not be read or are incomplete. They were kept without changes. Other available copies are shown below.
No active mods. You can return a mod from the Disabled mods tab.
No disabled mods in the vault.
Create groups of mods and switch between them. One group is active at a time; your core mods are included with every group. Close the game before switching.
Choose mods to include with every group. Saving this list does not move files; core mods are enabled when you next activate a group.
No groups yet. Create a group and choose its mods.
No matching mods. Add content to the game or return to the full list.
Not currently available. Remove it from the selection or restore its copy before activating the group.
Working… Keep the game closed until the operation finishes.

Close Melon Sandbox completely. This group and your core mods will be enabled; other active mods will move to the vault. An empty group leaves only core mods active. The current state will be saved for undo.
Close Melon Sandbox completely. Restore the mod state from before the last group switch. Undo stops if a new or modified file would be affected.
Delete this group definition? Game files and vault copies will stay as they are.
Group activated. Restart the game to use its mods.
The previous mod state was restored. Restart the game.
Saved. Activate a group when you are ready to change the game mods.
Group deleted. Mod files were kept.
A group switch did not finish. Open Mod groups and use Restore previous state before changing mods again.
Some vault records are unreadable or incomplete and were retained. A group cannot activate a missing or unverified copy.
The switch did not finish. The previous mod state was restored.
A selected mod is unavailable. Restore its copy or edit the group or core-mod list.
The mod state changed after the saved switch. The operation stopped to preserve your files. Refresh the list and review the current mods.
Different copies of the same mod are available. Enable the version you want from the mod tool first, then retry the group.
This selection is too large. Use fewer mods or shorter paths and try again.
Could not complete the operation. Reconnect Shizuku and refresh the groups. Check whether Restore previous state is available before retrying.
Connect Shizuku to check the current group.
Open groups to check the current state.
The scan found no files that need review.
Some folders could not be fully checked. Review the available results.
Structure error in a supported format
Kept as the reference for matching files
You can quarantine up to 40 files per operation.
Close Melon Sandbox completely. MelKit will verify a recovery copy before moving each selected file out of the game.
Quarantined files are kept in Download/MelKit/Quarantine. You can return each file to its original path.
Recovery copy from an interrupted operation
Close Melon Sandbox completely. The file will return to its original path after its contents are verified.
The file is available at its original path.
These scan results are out of date. Start a new scan.
A file or its reference changed. Refresh the list or start a new scan.
A different file occupies the original path. Both copies were kept.
The game folder or requested file is unavailable.
Access was blocked. Check the Shizuku connection and try again.
The operation did not finish. Refresh Quarantined files to check available recovery copies.
Scan this code on the receiving phone
Scan the MelKit code from the sender
This folder has no shareable files.
Close Melon Sandbox completely before continuing.
The receiving phone confirmed the verified batch.
The verified files are ready in Received files.
Connect Shizuku to import received files into Melon Sandbox.
A file already occupies the game path. Your received copy is available in Received files.
The file was placed in the game folder.
A verified copy was saved in Download/MelKit.
Send the installed APK using a sharing app on your phone.
Share the MelKit Google Play listing.
Grant the requested permission to continue.
Turn on Wi-Fi, then start sharing again.
Turn on Location services to pair on this Android version.
Wi-Fi Direct is unavailable on this phone.
Wi-Fi Direct is busy. End the current connection or wait for it to close, then try again.
The transfer timed out. Start again with a new QR.
Scan a current sharing code created by MelKit.
File verification failed. Check the sender files and try a new transfer.
Choose up to 100 supported Melon files. Each can be up to 2 GiB, with up to 8 GiB per batch.
Duplicate file names or paths were found. Review the selection or bundle.
A selected file changed or could not be read. Reconnect the source and select it again.
This batch is already saved. Open Received files.
Melon Sandbox could not be opened on this phone.
This installation uses multiple APK files. Share the project link instead.
The operation stopped. Check Received files before starting with a new QR.
Choose files, add an optional cover, and save one ZIP for sharing.
Open a saved or received MelKit bundle to review and restore its files.
Existing game files are skipped and preserved.
Restore %1$d selected files. Existing files will be skipped. Completed restores are kept if the batch stops.
The current file will finish before the batch stops.
Already in the game; skipped and preserved
Another operation is running. Try the remaining files after it finishes.
The operation did not finish. Check the file in the game before retrying.
The source copy changed or could not be verified.
The result could not be confirmed. Check whether the file is in the game.
Restored %1$d · Skipped %2$d · Could not complete %3$d · Not attempted %4$d
Files that could not be completed or were not attempted remain selected for retry.
Delete %1$s from its saved location? This cannot be undone.
Could not delete the file. Check access and try again.
An operation is in progress. Please wait; a restore batch can stop after the current file.
Choose the mods for each group. Core mods stay enabled when you switch.
Name the ZIP and review its files. Add an optional cover, then choose where to save it.
New bundles you create will appear here. Older ZIP files can still be opened using Open MelKit Bundle.
This provider did not grant lasting access. You may need to select the ZIP again after restarting.
This ZIP is missing, moved, or no longer accessible. Use Open MelKit Bundle to select it again.
Could not read or update the saved-bundle list. A ZIP already saved remains in its chosen location; open it manually.
Could not rename this document. Use a valid name and check whether its provider supports renaming.
Already in the game: skipped by default.
No file at this game path was found during review.
Game destination could not be checked. Import will check again and skip existing files.
The known file structure is invalid or empty. Import is disabled for this file.
This content format could not be fully checked. It is not classified as corrupt.
Same content as %1$s. Review your selection.
Downloads: %1$d saved, %2$d failed. See each file for its result.
Delete this game file? A verified safety copy is kept in Download/MelKit/ScanBackups. Quarantine is the recommended reversible option.
The original extension is kept. An existing filename will never be replaced.
Add files with Edit selection, or remove them from this preview. Game originals are preserved.
This source cannot be replaced safely. Save as a new bundle in a writable location.
Choose the folder containing the original ZIP to allow a verified replacement. The previous ZIP is kept as MelKit-before-edit-….zip. If the provider does not support this, save as a new bundle.
Discard these edits and leave the editor? The original bundle and game files are preserved.
Changes saved to the original bundle.
Could not verify a safety backup. The original bundle was not changed. You can save as a new bundle.
Could not save changes. The original bundle is intact or was restored. Your edits are still available; try saving as a new bundle.
The file provider stopped responding before recovery finished. Your original ZIP is safe in the backup shown below. Keep it and save your edits as a new bundle.
